name: Dumbbell Side Bend
steps: Stand tall holding one dumbbell at your side, feet shoulder width.
Rest your free hand on your hip.
Bend sideways toward the dumbbell, sliding it down your leg.
Breathe out and pull yourself back up with the opposite side.
Finish the set, then switch hands.
cues: Bend straight sideways, no leaning forward
Breathe out as you come up

common_mistakes.fix: Move as if between two walls
Use one dumbbell so the side has work to do
Pause at the bottom, then lift slowly
